price.paid: included with Zambo Pass (five full audits per month)

description: AI code audit for a public GitHub repository. Returns a Provibe score from 0 to 100, security vulnerabilities, a dead-code map, and an execution plan for addressing the findings. Required arguments: repo_url.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

email.description: Zambo Pass email for full audit (optional - without it you get the free teaser: score + top 3 issues). Get pass: https://zambo.dev/upgrade?tool=provibe_audit&tier=monthly

repo_url.description: Public GitHub repository URL. Example: https://github.com/owner/my-saas

vibe_context.description: Optional context: language, framework, specific concerns, or what the project does

name: provibe_audit

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.

title: Provibe Audit
